source.publication: Publication 120 Retirement Income (December 2025), with the 2025 IL-1040 Instructions and Form IL-1040
source.section: Pub 120 PDF page 2 'What retirement income may I subtract', PDF page 3 'What federally taxed income may I not subtract'; Form IL-1040 Line 5; Instructions PDF page 7, Line 5; Form IL-1040 PDF page 1, Lines 1-19; Instructions PDF page 8, Lines 10-12; rate Instructions PDF page 1; Line 10a chart and Income Exceptions, Instructions PDF page 8

worked: Federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 0) 60,000.00 + interest 13,850.00 = 73,850.00. Federal taxable income = 73,850.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - additional amount for 1 person(s) 65 or older 2,000.00 = 56,100.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Illinois starts from federal AGI). Form IL-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 73,850.00. Line 2 federally tax-exempt interest 0.00. Line 3 other additions 0.00. Line 4 = 73,850.00. Line 5 IRA distribution 60,000.00 = 60,000.00. Lines 6 and 7 0.00. Line 8 = 60,000.00. Line 9 base income = 73,850.00 - 60,000.00 = 13,850.00. Income Exceptions: federal AGI 73,850.00 is not greater than 250,000.00, so the allowance stands. Line 10a 2,850.00. Line 10b 1,000.00 (1 box(es) x 1,000.00). Lines 10c and 10d 0.00. Line 10 = 3,850.00. Line 11 net income = 13,850.00 - 3,850.00 = 10,000.00. Line 12 tax = 10,000.00 x 4.95% = 495.0000. Lines 13-18 0.00 (no credits in the projection). Line 19 state income tax = 495.00.
